summary: Specifies how to use IKE to set up IPsec security associations without authenticating the peer, an approach called Better-Than-Nothing Security. No wire format changes to IKEv2 are needed, though some database extensions are defined. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Sometimes you can lock the door without checking who is on the other side. It does not tell you who it is, but it still stops eavesdroppers from reading along.
